$comment: Messages addressed to part of a channel, shared by tests/shared/statusmsg.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest. Ops and bots talk to half a room at a time — PRIVMSG @#channel reaches everyone with @ or better — and neither client looked at the STATUSMSG token, so those lines arrived as a conversation called @#channel sitting beside the real one.
$cases: `statusmsg` is what the network advertised. `target` is what came in; `channel` and `status` are what it means.

a prefix this network does not use is part of the name
